description:
Jo Title: PeopleSoft Developer 
 Location: Herdon, VA 
 Contract Length: 7 month, contract to hire. 
 
 US Citizen, GC, GC/EAD Only 
 
 To design, develop, implement and maintain new IT solutions, or changes/enhancements to existing solutions that align with business initiatives and corporate strategies.
 
 Responsibilities: 
 · The PeopleSoft Developer is a developer in the technical delivery and support of PeopleSoft HCM and FSCM modules. 
 · The candidate must possess advanced (for the III)/ senior-level (for the II) experience working in two modules in PeopleSoft HCM/FSCM Version 9.2. 
 · The candidate must possess advanced (for the III)/ senior-level (for the II) ability to create technical documentation: ability to develop technical system designs, develop technical program specifications, and develop technical testing requirements. · 
 · Refine and decompose requirements to the level of detail required to initiate coding · 
 · Review and accept software and interface design and requirements · 
 · Implement code as specified in the design and ensures the implemented software fully satisfies functional and technical requirements · 
 · Develop technical system design documents · 
 · Participate in functional BRD and technical design reviews 
 
 Required Skills: 
 Level III - Minimum 7 years 
 · progressive work experience focused on PeopleSoft application design, development, documentation, testing, and implementation in full life-cycle projects 
 
 Level III - Minimum 7 years 


 If you are interested in above position, please share your updated resume to gmahesh(at)usmsystems(dot)com or can directly call me on 703-880-4184.
